text:
sara_support: FYI customer Acetron is hitting indexer failures during a backfill. Their vector DB rejects inserts with a dimension mismatch. Error: "DimensionMismatchError: expected 1024, got 1536". Started ~09:10 PST. Can we triage?

nate_indexer: ack. Seeing a batch of failed bulk-inserts from argo-indexer job id=backfill-2026-03-17. Logs show repeated 422/insert-rejects and some 401s to the embeddings endpoint right before the dim error.

ryan_oncall: heatmap from the last hour: 401 spikes at 09:07-09:12, 429 spikes between 09:12-09:22, then dumps of 422 dimension errors from indexer workers. Possibly token refresh + rate-limit cascading into schema mismatch for backfill output.

ops-bot: deploy-bot detected model rollout rw-embed-large@v2.1 -> rw-embed-large@v3.0 at 09:05 UTC in hosted. Change triggered without pinned-backfills flag.

sara_support: that matches timeline. Customer says everything was fine yesterday; they started backfill at 08:55 UTC. At 09:05 we pushed v3.0 which returns 1536-dim vectors. Their vector DB (StoneDB) schema is locked to 1024 dims.

tina_embed: confirmation: rw-embed-large@v3.0 uses the new transformer head -> 1536 floats. v2.1 produced 1024. v3.0 should have been behind a canary. We missed the backfill pin.

nate_indexer: repro steps I used locally:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"rw-embed-large","input":"hello world"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
```
returns 1536 on prod v3.0, 1024 on v2.1.

ryan_oncall: indexer log snippet: 
```
File: argo-indexer/worker-7.log
[09:14:33] ERROR InsertTask failed: DimensionMismatchError: 1536 != 1024
[09:14:33] INFO Requeueing 68 docs to retry-queue
[09:14:34] WARN Upstream 429 RateLimitedError on batch-42
[09:14:34] ERROR AuthError: 401 Unauthorized contacting embeddings service (token expired)
```

sara_support: customer impact: backfill aborted after 3 attempts, 18k docs stuck in retry queue. They reported a spike in billing spikes/alerts at same time — possible retry storms.

evan_billing: looked at their account: they hit monthly credit threshold and account was put into a soft-block, causing rejected billing operations which may have returned 401-ish responses for some internal calls. I'm opening a temporary credits top-up while we stabilize.

ops-bot: security-bot scanned rollout change; no policy violation. But rollout did not respect "do-not-affect-long-running-jobs" tag.

nate_indexer: proposed immediate mitigation:
- Pin the embeddings model used by ArgoIndexer back to rw-embed-large@v2.1 for all backfill lanes (hotfix).
- Put the backfill job into paused state and drain retry-queue to avoid double-retries.
- Add a temporary converter that pads/truncates vectors to 1024 only for the stuck queue as a last-resort migration path.

tina_embed: longer-term: require model-major-version pinning for any long-running ingest jobs; add a preflight check for embedding dims before accepting a bulk job (fast-head call). Also add a canary window that excludes ongoing backfills.

ryan_oncall: immediate action list (I can run these now):
1) roll back hosted rw-embed-large to v2.1 for region us-west-2 (will take ~3m).
2) pause backfill job backfill-2026-03-17 and move 18k docs to a quarantine S3 prefix.
3) run a small re-embed job using rw-embed-large@v2.1 on 100 samples to confirm dims=1024.
4) once confirmed, resume backfill with pinned model.

sara_support: please coordinate with evan for the temporary credits and notify Acetron. I'll open a customer postmortem ticket and offer to do a temporary free re-run on our side once we fix.

evan_billing: credits applied for 72 hours. sent email to Acetron billing contact.

nate_indexer: quick helper script I ran to detect which backfill batches are contaminated:
```
python tools/check_embeddings_dim.py --s3-prefix s3://acme-backfills/backfill-2026-03-17/ | head
batch-0001.json -> 1024
batch-0002.json -> 1536
batch-0003.json -> 1536
```
I'll share the full output to the backfill incident channel.

tina_embed: one gotcha: some downstream vector DBs accept variable-length embeddings by silently truncating/padding which hides the bug. StoneDB enforces strict dims, so this surfaced. Recommend adding embed-dim metadata to our index requests so DBs can validate earlier.

ryan_oncall: timeline for rollback + verify: ~25 minutes. I'll update when rollback done.

ops-bot: rollback started by ryan_oncall at 09:28 UTC.

ryan_oncall: rollback complete. Verified rw-embed-large reports 1024 for test sample. Unpausing the backfill only after we run a small resumed test.

sara_support: customer notified and asked for ETA on full backfill. Tell them we'll re-run the 18k docs on our infra this evening if they'd like.

nate_indexer: follow-ups for engineering tickets: ENG-idx-4524 pin-backfills, ENG-embed-1789 dim-preflight, SRE-ops-2211 canary-controls. I'll create PRs for the pad/truncate helper but prefer not to use it except for emergency migrations.

sara_support: thanks team. reactions: :thumbsup: :heartbeat:

ryan_oncall: update 10:05 UTC: backfill resumed in small-window with pinned model; first sanity batch succeeded. Closing channel unless new failures.

ops-bot: incident note created: incident/2026-03-17-embed-dim-drift (severity: medium).
